answer_1.quote: In this work, we address occupational gender bias ... in one of the, arguably, most prominent NLP applications to date, machine translation (MT).
answer_1.outputs: Translated sentences in the target language (Spanish or German)

answer_2.quote: We use the state-of-the-art Europarl corpus to evaluate zero-shot translation quality. We use the benchmark evaluation metrics COMET (reference-based -22 and reference-free -20) and BERTScore. We also include BLEU (-2 and -4) for comparison with prior work.
